test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the correct statement about the achievements of Sruti Bandopadhay, an eminent Manipuri dancer.

options.text: She received Padma Shri for the year 2020.
She received Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for the year 2020.
She received Kalidas Samman for the year 2020.
She received Padma Vibhushan for the year 2020.

solution:
The correct answer is __**She received Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for the year 2020.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sruti Bandopadhay** is a** renowned Manipuri dancer** who has contributed significantly to the **promotion and preservation **of** Manipuri dance.**
 
• She has been awarded the** Sangeet Natak Akademi Award,** which is the highest national recognition given to performing artists, for the year **2020.**
 
• Sruti Bandopadhay has been a recipient of several other awards and honors, including the** Nritya Choodamani award** and the **Rajiv Gandhi National Sadbhavana award.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sruti Bandopadhay has **not received **the Kalidas Samman or the Padma Awards.
